assessments.headline: Resinate Douglas — $48,201 account is now 69 days quiet and still has no owner
assessments.assessment: The #3 account of 2026 ($48,201 over 6 orders, normally every ~37 days) is 69 days since its last order, up from 62 at last Monday's brief, and it is still Unassigned. It is the largest line in the $246,543 revenue-at-risk list, and last-90-day spend is $8,162 against $36,838 the period before, the steepest fade in the book. Resinate Worcester (Joey, $26,325, 24 days since last on a ~33-day cycle) is on pace, so this is a Douglas problem.
assessments.action: Matt: assign Douglas to Joey today. Joey: call the Douglas buyer by Wednesday, find out what changed on the bulk orders, and quote the next one before Friday.

assessments.headline: Seaside Orleans — A+ account at $37,863 is 59 days silent on a 27-day cycle
assessments.assessment: Seaside ($37,863 in 2026 over 8 orders, grade A+) normally reorders every ~27 days and is now 59 days out, more than twice its normal gap. Last-90-day spend is $7,750 against $18,340 the period before. It was 52 days at last Monday's brief, so another week has gone by without an order from a top-five account.
assessments.action: Joey: get to Orleans in person this week, find out who is buying and what replaced us, and leave with an order. Matt: if there is no order by Friday, call the owner yourself.

assessments.headline: Eastern Cannabis Malden — #1 account ($61,602) is due for its reorder today
assessments.assessment: Eastern is the largest account of 2026 at $61,602 across 10 orders and reorders every ~27 days. It is exactly 27 days since the last order, so the reorder is due today. In a week where only 4 orders came in, this is the single call most likely to put a large order on the board.
assessments.action: Joey: call the Malden buyer today and book the order. Charley: hold a delivery slot for Malden this week.

assessments.headline: Orders fell to 4 ($21,286) last week from 13 ($68,388) the week before
assessments.assessment: The tracker shows 4 orders worth $21,286 in the last 7 days against 13 worth $68,388 the prior week, a drop of more than two thirds in both count and dollars. All four came on 9/28 and 9/29; nothing is logged after that. The activity log shows no calls or visits last week (Joey: 12 order entries and 1 note; Matt: 1 email and 3 tasks). Five accounts that have done $129,956 between them in 2026 are due this week, so the volume is there to recover.
assessments.action: Joey: if orders were taken after 9/29 and not entered, enter them today; then work the five due-this-week accounts in order of size. Matt: review the week with Joey this morning and set a call target for each day.

assessments.headline: Lazy River Dracut — $19,504 account is 49 days out on a 22-day cycle
assessments.assessment: Lazy River Dracut ($19,504 in 2026, grade B) is one of the fastest reorderers in the book at ~22 days and is now 49 days since its last order, more than twice its normal gap. It was 42 days at last Monday's brief. It is the third-largest line on the revenue-at-risk list.
assessments.action: Joey: call Dracut today, check what is left on the shelf from the last delivery, and book a delivery for this week. Charley: hold a slot on the north route for it.

assessments.headline: Harbor House Chelsea — $16,800 past due, the largest past-due balance, and owned by 'Team'
assessments.assessment: Harbor House owes $16,800 and all of it is now past due, the oldest invoice by 3 days. That is a quarter of the $67,044 past due across the book and the largest single line on the list. The account is assigned to 'Team', so no one person is responsible for the call.
assessments.action: Dan: confirm today whether a payment is in transit and send a statement if not. Matt: put one name on this account. Charley: check with Dan before the next Chelsea delivery.

assessments.headline: Ascend Wellness — $16,899 past due across three stores, up to 23 days late
assessments.assessment: New Bedford ($7,234), Newton ($6,640) and Boston ($3,025 of $6,345 owed) are all past due, the oldest invoice by 23 days, up from 16 last Monday. New Bedford is also 41 days since its last order on a ~20-day cycle, and Newton ($16,226 in 2026) is due for reorder in 4 days. Both stores have 'Planned' order rows dated 9/21 with no confirmation, so new product may be about to go out against an unpaid balance.
assessments.action: Dan: send Ascend AP a statement for all three stores today and get a payment date. Joey: confirm whether the 9/21 Newton and New Bedford orders are real. Charley: check with Dan before delivering any new Ascend order.

assessments.headline: Embr/Fyre Ants group — $87,499 of 2026 revenue with no owner and $7,072 past due
assessments.assessment: Springfield ($35,744), Easthampton ($23,845), Worcester ($16,255) and Northampton ($11,655) are all Unassigned. Easthampton ($3,792) and Northampton ($3,280) are both 8 days past due, and Worcester has not ordered in 201 days after a single $16,255 order. Springfield is 47 days since last on a ~73-day cycle, so there is time to get in front of the next order.
assessments.action: Matt: assign the four locations to one rep today. Dan: chase the $7,072 past due this week. Joey: ask the group buyer about Worcester on the first call.

assessments.headline: Enlite Northampton — $4,825 past due for 32 days, with an Indian Orchard order planned for 10/6
assessments.assessment: Enlite Northampton owes $4,825 and it is 32 days past due, the oldest on the past-due list (it was 25 days last Monday). The tracker has a 'Planned' Northampton row dated 9/15 that was never confirmed and a 'Planned' Indian Orchard row for 10/6, so the group may receive new product tomorrow while the old balance is open.
assessments.action: Dan: call Enlite AP today for a payment date. Charley: check with Dan before the 10/6 Indian Orchard delivery. Joey: confirm or delete the 9/15 Northampton row.

assessments.headline: Apex Noire ($4,925) and Firehouse ($5,452) are past due while still ordering
assessments.assessment: Apex Noire ordered $4,250 on 9/29 and now owes $9,175, of which $4,925 is past due (5 days late). Firehouse, the #4 account at $43,376, owes $12,333 with $5,452 past due (10 days late) and last ordered 11 days ago. Both are good accounts buying on schedule; the risk is the balance growing with each delivery.
assessments.action: Dan: confirm payment status on both this week. Joey: ask for payment on your next call with each buyer. Charley: check with Dan before the next delivery to either.

assessments.headline: Roadtrip Salisbury ($20,928) and LowKey West Roxbury ($14,055) are both due in 3 days
assessments.assessment: Roadtrip reorders every ~43 days and has a 'Planned' row dated 9/24 that is still unconfirmed, so an order may already be in motion. LowKey is due on its ~58-day cycle but is fading ($3,775 last 90 days against $10,280 before) and has $3,775 that is 10 days past due. Ember Gardens Boston ($17,144, every ~46 days) is due in 4 days and sits with Charley.
assessments.action: Joey: confirm the 9/24 Roadtrip order and put the total in the tracker; call LowKey and ask for the $3,775 with the reorder. Charley: place the Ember Gardens Boston order this week.

assessments.headline: Sublime Mashpee — #2 account ($50,731) is up to $23,325 from $16,578; protect it
assessments.assessment: Sublime has placed 9 orders for $50,731 in 2026 and its last-90-day spend is $23,325 against $16,578 the period before. It ordered 11 days ago on a ~27-day cycle, so the next order is about two weeks out. Reverie 73 Beverly ($35,647, 9 orders) is on the same path at $15,146 against $10,725 and is 20 days into a ~31-day cycle.

assessments.headline: 50 active accounts have no owner — including Capeway Carver ($27,677, nearly doubled)
assessments.assessment: Unassigned active accounts rose to 50 from 49 last week. Capeway Carver ($27,677 in 2026, 8 orders) is at $18,165 for the last 90 days against $9,512 before, and three more unassigned accounts are growing or sizeable: The Vault Worcester ($9,190 vs $5,249), Healing Center Fitchburg ($9,835 vs $6,301) and Bliss Cannabis Lunenburg ($18,497 in 2026). Rising accounts with no owner are the easiest revenue in the book to lose.
assessments.action: Matt: assign Capeway Carver, The Vault Worcester, Healing Center and Bliss this week, then work down the rest of the unassigned list by 2026 revenue.

assessments.headline: Zenleaf Sharon is up 3.4x ($12,535 vs $3,675); Elysian and Bud Barn are climbing too
